comment: do_wear.c select_off() 2752-2755 and dothrow.c throwit() 1669: a hero stuck in the floor (TT_INFLOOR). A debug Valkyrie wears wished iron shoes (lava would burn leather boots), puts on a ring of fire resistance, reads a wished uncursed scroll of punishment and picks up the ball, wishes lava under herself (she sinks in, TT_LAVA) and zaps a wand of cold down: zap_over_floor() solidifies the lava and sets TT_INFLOOR ('You are firmly stuck in the cooling rock.'). Taking off the shoes is refused ('You are stuck in the floor'), and throwing the carried ball gets range 1.
